'''Dillwit''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who had been stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Dillwit recently engaged to which he celebrated with his friends, along with [[Nova Stihl]]. He was presumed killed during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] when the Death Star blew up.
